listing.name: Saboteur II: Avenging Angel (Saboteur II x86-64 recomp)
listing.summary: Saboteur II: Avenging Angel native recompilation; fresh acquisition retains the existing embedded-original-data condition, with guidance for a permitted existing copy.
listing.download_block_reason: Fresh package/build acquisition remains held under #2722: upstream embeds original SAB2.COM data in every binary, and an attributable grant covering distribution of those original materials has not been established. The port-code Unlicense permits compiled redistribution of that software; it does not resolve the separately recorded original-data condition. Reconsider on attributable original-content distribution evidence or a reviewed route creating those materials from the player’s own inputs. These instructions grant no permission to acquire, register or execute a copy.

steps.title: Check the existing acquisition condition
steps.instruction: Upstream’s published player needs no separate original-file picker because it embeds data from SAB2.COM. Fresh package/build acquisition remains held until the existing original-content distribution condition is resolved. Published checksums and technical package fit are separate facts. Keep any currently usable permitted copy and its files; no download, setup helper or game runs during discovery.

steps.title: Keep a permitted existing player together
steps.instruction: If you already have a native copy you are permitted to use, keep its complete matching runtime. On Windows x64 choose saboteur2.exe beside SDL2.dll, with its folder as the working directory. Linux x64 uses saboteur2 and requires system SDL2 and glibc 2.34 or newer according to upstream. Save launch details, then choose Play deliberately. Mac versions follow their own upstream instructions. Registration preserves external ownership and does not grant permission to use a copy.

steps.title: Preserve actual settings and progress
steps.instruction: The player normally stores fullscreen settings and high scores in SDL’s per-user petarov/saboteur2 preferences folder. When that folder is unavailable, high scores can fall back to SAB_II.SCR in the working directory; preserve that file too. Forced quit keys do not save scores. Before changing versions, close the game and keep a separate copy of the working runtime and actual preferences/fallback file. You or upstream own runtime updates. Portcove does not manage, back up, restore, roll back or delete these external runtime or player-data files.
